readings.interpretation: Perfect alignment with fate - all forces aligned, outcome certain, moment of transformation. The boundary between worlds is at its thinnest.
readings.meaning: This hand represents the establishment of the Realm of Gaming and Gambling. All probability flows are aligned. The realm is born under perfect conditions.

readings.interpretation: The mirror - shows what could have been, the inverse of fate. Where Spades show what will happen, Hearts show what could have been.
readings.meaning: This realm could have been many things, but it chose to be a place of documentation, truth, and witness. The mirror shows the path not taken.
